identity_block: The hand is Grace's real hand from the hand reference photo: warm brown skin, square medium-length nails painted pink with crisp white French tips, her small gold ring with a clear heart-shaped stone on one finger and her silver crown-style engagement ring on the ring finger. One hand only, entering from the frame edge with the wrist visible, no forearm, hand small in the frame, natural relaxed fingers, five fingers, realistic knuckles and skin texture.
pouch_block: Each pouch is the real SoFyre pouch from the pouch reference photo: a plain WHITE soft non-woven sachet about the size of a palm, slightly puffy, rectangular, with zig-zag pinked sealed edges and no print. Not a tea bag, not a box, not a packet with writing.
video_suffix: Handheld phone camera, smooth natural motion, real speed, every object keeps its exact shape, colour and count in every frame, the black bag never changes its print, no flicker, no morphing, no extra fingers, no text.
bag_block: The SoFyre bag is the product from the bag reference sheet: a TALL matte BLACK stand-up zip pouch bag (its height is about one and a half times its width, like a coffee bag, never short and wide) with a faint dark polygon pattern, small white serif word SOFYRE at the top center, small white '12 POUCHES' at the top right, big bold white word RODENT, big bold lime-green word REPELLENT, white word POUCHES, a white geometric line-art mouse face, a row of small lime-green circle icons, and a white band with small black text across the bottom. Keep its exact shape, colours and layout; it never changes.
scene_v1: Bright Scandinavian-style home on a cold winter morning, white walls, pale oak, crisp cool daylight from big windows, clean neutral white balance, real phone camera look, sharp focus, no text, no logos except the SoFyre bag's own print, no watermark.
scene_v2: Bright cozy family home in daytime, soft neutral daylight, cream and grey tones, clean neutral white balance (not golden, not dark), real phone camera look, sharp focus, no text, no logos except the SoFyre bag's own print, no watermark.
scene_v3: Bright farmhouse-style home on a crisp frosty morning, white shiplap, butcher block, sage accents, clean bright neutral daylight, real phone camera look, sharp focus, no text, no logos except the SoFyre bag's own print, no watermark.

shots.vo: One thing I wouldn't wait until winter for? Mouse prevention.
shots.still: Entryway at eye level: knit scarf and winter boots on a pale oak bench by a frosty window. Grace's hand enters from the right frame edge and holds the TALL black SoFyre stand-up bag up by its top zip edge, thumb on the front and four fingers curled around the back, the full bag front facing the camera, filling the middle of the frame, with the print exactly as in the bag reference photos: small serif SOFYRE, big white RODENT, lime-green REPELLENT, white POUCHES, white line-art mouse face, white band at the bottom.
shots.video: The hand lifts the bag up and toward the camera while the camera rises and pushes in fast; the bag stays gripped and its print never changes.

shots.vo: When temperatures drop, mice start looking for somewhere warm, and your house could be their next stop.
shots.still: Low ground-level view across a frosty back patio in morning sun toward a white back door with a small gap under it. One small grey mouse on the frosted stone in the middle distance, facing the door.
shots.video: The mouse scurries fast across the frost to the door and squeezes under the gap; the low camera tracks quickly after it. One mouse only.

shots.vo: These peppermint and cinnamon oil pouches are easy to place around the house,
shots.still: Bright white marble counter by a window with snow outside. The black SoFyre bag stands upright and open on the left with fresh peppermint leaves and two cinnamon sticks beside it. Grace's hand enters from the right edge and pinches one white pouch by its top edge between thumb and index finger, lifting it out of the bag.
shots.video: The hand lifts the pouch out and away while the camera orbits smoothly to the right around the bag; nothing on the counter moves.

shots.vo: from the pantry
shots.still: Bright pantry with pale oak shelves and woven baskets. Grace's hand enters from the bottom right edge holding one white pouch pinched between thumb and index finger above the back of a low shelf beside a woven basket.
shots.video: The hand lowers the pouch onto the shelf behind the basket, lets go and slides out of frame; the camera pushes in to the pouch.

shots.vo: to the garage.
shots.still: Bright clean garage with white walls and grey plastic storage bins on a metal rack. Grace's hand enters from the right frame edge pinching one white pouch between thumb and index finger above the top of a storage bin.
shots.video: The hand sets the pouch on the bin lid and pulls away out of frame; the camera trucks left along the rack.

shots.vo: Get ahead of mouse season before they move in. It's in the orange cart.
shots.still: One black SoFyre bag stands upright alone on a white windowsill, front facing the camera, snow falling softly outside the window, a white pouch lying flat beside it.
shots.video: Smooth arc-and-push dolly around the bag from the left until its front fills the frame, snow drifting past the window; the bag stays upright and unchanged. One bag only.

shots.vo: Let's not make room for these guests.
shots.still: Bright living room in daytime seen from behind a grey sofa: two adults sit on the sofa with their backs to the camera, the backs of their heads and shoulders only, facing a white brick fireplace with a small calm fire. The black SoFyre bag stands upright on a wooden coffee table at the left. Grace's hand enters from the bottom right frame edge, index finger pointing forward past the two people toward the fireplace, other fingers curled. On the stone hearth beside the fireplace sits one small grey mouse.
shots.video: The pointing hand holds still and steady while the camera pushes in past the two people toward the hearth until the mouse is clear; the mouse twitches its nose; the people stay still with their backs to the camera. One mouse only.

shots.vo: The last thing you want is to find mouse droppings in your pantry when the weather gets cold.
shots.still: Bright pantry shelf at eye level with glass jars of pasta and rice. Grace's hand grips the side of one glass jar, fingers wrapped around it, starting to slide it aside to reveal a few small dark mouse droppings on the shelf behind it.
shots.video: The hand slides the jar to the side revealing the droppings while the camera pushes in to them; the droppings stay still. Clean, not gross.

shots.vo: These pouches use peppermint and cinnamon oil to help repel mice.
shots.still: Overhead top-down view of a round wooden tray on a light table: the black SoFyre bag lying flat front up, a few white pouches, peppermint leaves and cinnamon sticks. Grace's hand enters from the right edge and pinches one white pouch by its edge between thumb and index finger.
shots.video: The overhead camera slowly rotates and lowers while the hand lifts the pouch up out of frame; nothing else on the tray moves.

shots.vo: Just place them in the areas you want to protect, including under the sink
shots.still: Open under-sink cabinet painted soft sage green, white pipes, a few cleaning bottles. Grace's hand enters from the bottom frame edge pinching one white pouch between thumb and index finger, reaching toward the back corner behind the bottles.
shots.video: The hand sets the pouch down in the back corner, lets go and pulls back out of frame; the camera pushes in and tilts down to the pouch.

shots.vo: and in the garage.
shots.still: Low view along the clean concrete floor of a bright garage to the inside corner of the closed white garage door, one white pouch lying flat on the floor by the door seal.
shots.video: Fast low dolly along the floor toward the pouch, ending close on it; nothing moves.

shots.vo: Prepare now, not later. Orange cart.
shots.still: One black SoFyre bag stands upright alone on a white wooden fireplace mantel, front facing the camera, a small calm fire below, bright living room.
shots.video: Quick smooth push-in and slight arc until the bag front fills the frame; the bag stays upright and unchanged. One bag only.

shots.vo: One thing I'd handle before winter?
shots.still: Farmhouse kitchen table with a butcher block top in front of a frosty window with sage green cabinets. ONE tall black SoFyre stand-up bag stands upright alone on the table, its full front facing the camera, filling the middle of the frame, with the print exactly as in the bag reference photos: small serif SOFYRE, big white RODENT, lime-green REPELLENT (said once), white POUCHES, white line-art mouse face, white band at the bottom. No hand, no other objects on the table.
shots.video: Fast smooth arc-and-push around the bag from the left while the camera rises slightly, frost on the window glittering; the bag stays upright and unchanged.

shots.vo: Mice.
shots.still: Close shot of a kitchen counter corner with a white ceramic flour canister; one small grey mouse peeks its head out from behind the canister.
shots.video: Fast push-in toward the mouse as it pokes its head out and sniffs; the canister never moves. One mouse only.

shots.vo: Once it gets cold, they're looking for warmth, and your home can look pretty inviting.
shots.still: Wide view across a frosty front lawn on a bright clear morning toward a white farmhouse with warm-lit windows. One small grey mouse in the frosty grass in the foreground, facing the house.
shots.video: The camera glides low behind the mouse as it runs across the frosty lawn toward the house. One mouse only.

shots.vo: These peppermint and cinnamon oil pouches are easy to place in the pantry,
shots.still: Bright farmhouse pantry with white shelves and wire baskets of potatoes and onions on the floor. Grace's hand enters from the top right edge pinching one white pouch between thumb and index finger above the floor beside the baskets.
shots.video: The hand lowers the pouch to the floor beside the baskets, lets go and pulls up out of frame; the camera tilts down and pushes in.

shots.vo: under the sink,
shots.still: Open white under-sink cabinet with chrome pipes and a dish soap bottle. Grace's hand enters from the left frame edge pinching one white pouch between thumb and index finger beside the pipe.
shots.video: The hand sets the pouch down beside the pipe and pulls back out of frame; the camera slides right.

shots.vo: or in the garage.
shots.still: Bright garage workbench with a pegboard of tools on a white wall. Grace's hand enters from the right edge pinching one white pouch between thumb and index finger above the bench beside a red toolbox.
shots.video: The hand drops the pouch on the bench and pulls away out of frame; the camera arcs left along the bench.

shots.vo: Twelve come in a bag, and each lasts up to three months.
shots.still: Overhead top-down view of a light wood table: the black SoFyre bag lying flat front up at the top, and exactly twelve white pouches in three neat rows of four below it.
shots.video: The overhead camera slowly rotates clockwise and lowers; nothing on the table moves and the count stays exactly twelve.

shots.vo: Check the orange cart.
shots.still: One black SoFyre bag stands upright alone on a white shelf in a bright farmhouse kitchen, front facing the camera.
shots.video: Fast smooth push-in until the bag front fills the frame; the bag stays upright and unchanged. One bag only.
